references.text: Describes impurity that lasts until evening, the same principle that sunset marks the end of impurity
Similar rules about impurity lasting until evening after touching unclean things
Concerns eating holy things after cleansing at sunset
The immediate context explaining who is unclean and that they must wait until sunset
Refers to the priests' right to eat from the holy offerings
Sunset marks the end of impurity, the same principle
An example of sunset as the time for a change in status
Prophetic confirmation that the priests shall eat the grain offering and the holy gifts
